zh-HK: NB M0／M1-M5 對齊公司 KPI：按 Sold-to 計算，同期季度重新落單唔再當 NB，N6 起轉 EB（當月、季度、年度及過去紀錄一致）
Customer Report Segmentation 同 NB 用同一套規則；National Leader 視圖保留集團計法
Account adjustment 合併為單一「調整方式」（剔走整個 account／只剔 NB／加入 EB／加入 NB／只加 NB）；Margin adjustment 只保留 EB／NB
MTD／NB KPI 保留零 Sales row 的實際 Cash Margin
Margin adjustment、Account adjustment 及 E-coupon Restore 可刪除最後一行；Sales History Order picker 支援多選及無 Order No. 彙總
en: NB M0 / M1-M5 now match the company KPI: Sold-to based, same-quarter reactivations are not NB, and N6 moves to EB across monthly, quarterly, yearly and history views
Customer Report segmentation uses the same NB rules; the National Leader view keeps the group roll-up
Account adjustment is now a single 'Adjustment' choice (remove whole account / remove from NB only / add EB / add NB / add to NB only); Margin adjustment keeps EB / NB only
MTD / NB KPIs keep the actual Cash Margin of zero-Sales rows
The last row of Margin adjustment, Account adjustment and E-coupon Restore can now be cleared; the Sales History order picker supports multi-select and grouping without Order No.
